connector.name: Azure IoT Hub
connector.registryDescription: MCP server for Azure IoT Hub: device registry, twins, methods, jobs, messaging.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package azure-iot-hub-mcp-server. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nagarjunr account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: AZURE_IOT_HUB_CONNECTION_STRING
env.description: IoT Hub connection string with service/iothubowner rights, e.g. HostName=my-hub.azure-devices.net;SharedAccessKeyName=service;SharedAccessKey=...
